<script>
  const defaultDocuments = {
    "sovereign-trust": "BDDB-ST-001_WhatIsSovereignTrust",
    "sovereigntrust": "BDDB-ST-000_Table_Of_Contents",
    "point-break": "SDA-PB-000_Point-Break-Starting-Point-Break",
    "sda-skydeck": "SDA-SKY-000_SkyDeck-Pulse-Index",
    "sda-studio":"SDA-SDA-001_Intro-To-SDA",
    "sda-frame": "SDA-FRM-000_CuratorialIndex",
    "sda-fusion": "SDA-FUS-000_SDA-Fusion-Summary",
    "bddb": "SDA-BDDB-000_BDDB-Blog-Summary",
    "signals": "SDA-SDA-000_Signals-Publication-Constellation",
    "pulses": "SDA-SDA-000_Pulses-Publication-Constellation"
  };

  // Try to get `signal` query param
  let tag = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("pulse");

  if (!tag) {
    // If no query param, use pathname fallback
    const pathSegments = window.location.pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean); // remove empty strings
    const lastSegment = pathSegments[pathSegments.length - 1] || "pulses";
    tag = defaultDocuments[lastSegment.toLowerCase()] || "SDA-SDA-000_Pulses-Publication-Constellation";
  }

  // Extract folder structure from tag
  const parts = tag.split("-");
  const folder1 = parts[0] || "sda";
  const folder2 = parts[1] || "sda";

  // Compose the full virtual path
  const path = `/application/files/publication/${folder1}/${folder2}/${tag}.md`;

  // Load and render markdown
  fetch(path)
    .then(res => {
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("File not found");
      return res.text();
    })
    .then(md => {
      document.getElementById("markdown-content").innerHTML = marked.parse(md);
    })
    .catch(err => {
      document.getElementById("markdown-content").innerText = "Could not load article.";
      console.error(err);
    });
</script>
